items.title: These are the cybersecurity stocks built for the AI era
items.summary: Wedbush Securities' vice president of TMT Equity Research, Steven Wahrhaftig, joins Yahoo Finance's Ines Ferré to discuss key cybersecurity stocks, including CrowdStrike (CRWD) and Palo Alto Networks (PANW), that could be worth considering for investors following recent breaches such as the OpenAI-Hugging Face hack.

items.title: What Happens To Cloudflare Stock If Its Growth Cools?
items.summary: Cloudflare (NET) has returned about 61% in three months and trades at or near its three-year high. The question on holders' minds is plain: what happens if its growth cools? The company has guided revenue growth for the third quarter of 2026 to 31%, and its CFO says the way customers now pay makes each quarter harder to forecast.

items.title: Is CrowdStrike Stock A Buy Today As AI Threats Lift Demand?
items.summary: The popular view of CrowdStrike (CRWD) is that AI has made a fast-growing security company grow even faster. The stock returned 98% over the past year. The S&P 500 returned 18.5% over the same period. For that view to be right, two things must both be true. The faster growth has to last, and it has to turn into real profit. So far, only the first one clearly holds.

items.title: Fortinet Stock Jumps on Security Platform Demand: What's Ahead?
items.summary: FTNT shares hit a 52-week high as platform demand accelerates, with AI security expansion and raised 2026 guidance adding momentum.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Launches AI-Powered Continuous Security Testing Service
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) has introduced Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense, a cybersecurity service designed to identify vulnerabilities and provide remediation guidance through continuous AI-powered testing. The service combines AI models from Anthropic and OpenAI within a proprietary multi-model system, allowing different security tasks to be assigned to the model considered most suitable.
